name: CF ClkT
description: Clock and block-budget diagnostic: per block it reads TSCL and the TIMER64P0 counter (19.2 MHz oscillator), times a knob-set busy loop, and once per frame reads PLLC0 and PDCCMD. Reports by tone code (tools/decode_memprobe.py). Mutes the guitar. Never save it in a patch.

params.name: Load
params.explanation: Busy loop: knob x 200 dependent multiply-adds per block, timed by TSCL.
